title: Tight Complexity Bounds for the LIM21 LowMC Attack
summary: The published LowMC attack analysis uses an n-to-the-2.8 Gaussian-elimination estimate without constants; tight overall bounds and a justified elimination cost remain open.

formal_statement.body: The unresolved question concerns the algebraic attack on LowMC reported in LIM21. Its published complexity analysis uses an $n^{2.8}$ estimate for Gaussian elimination while ignoring constant factors, so the tightness of the reported attack-complexity bounds is unclear. The task is to establish tight computational-complexity bounds for this LowMC attack, including a justified cost for its Gaussian-elimination step. [S1]

scope.domain: Algebraic cryptanalysis of LowMC and computational-cost analysis of the LIM21 attack.
parameters: n: variable governing the Gaussian-elimination cost estimate
scope.unresolved_remainder: Establish tight computational-complexity bounds for the LIM21 LowMC algebraic attack, including a justified Gaussian-elimination cost.
